statement: MotionPlus input-node opening changes hid-wiimote shared kernel state, while raw HID reads occur on the same kernel HID object and do not themselves increment that MotionPlus input-node open state. Keeping the evdev node open may maintain the kernel's mapping while a separate SDL process uses hidraw, but this is conditional on kernel re-evaluation, successful mapping, permissions and SDL not resetting or superseding the mapping. Neither v6.12 nor the pinned mainline code guarantees a stable multi-consumer order.

applicability.revision: Linux hid-wiimote v6.12 and mainline 734bef5; source behavior, no host runtime
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Modules MP open/close and core init_hotplug plus mapped-state check 950-1065; compare SDL initial extension probe 677-709. Hypothesis for host verification, not a measured pass.
